$comment: The axes of the shared internal-reference gate (@cosyte/script-utils, `cosyte-internal-refs`, ST34) for this repository: no item identifiers, phase or wave words, ADR numbers, internal paths or traceability markers on what a consumer reads (the README, LICENSE, docs-content/, the npm description and keywords, and the doc comments in src/ that compile into dist/index.d.ts).

accountedTarballFiles: CHANGELOG.md is written by the release from the changesets, which the shared release tooling already refuses when they carry internal identifiers; dist is untracked build output whose source is gated by the doc-comment pass.

The extra samples are date and time forms a reader of these docs needs, so an engine release that widened a rule into the WORD-N shape reds here instead of deleting them from the documentation. Samples add to the engine floor; nothing here can remove one.

positives: Item HL7-N is done, and CCDA-P7 with it
negatives: ISO-8601 dates and RFC-3339 timestamps, the HL7 v2 DTM and TS types, PID-7 date of birth, OBR-7 observation time, HL7-V2 and FHIR-R4, the IANA zone America/New_York, an offset written UTC-05:00 or +05:30, a year of 1988 and a date of 1988-05-07

positives: Phase 5b closes it (Phase W, Phase-L and the thirteenth slice landed earlier, in wave 2)
negatives: A daylight-saving transition, the phase of the moon, and a clock that stays in phase with the source system

positives: Decided in ADR 0015 and restated in ADR-0021
negatives: A year such as 2024 alone is a value, not a decision record

positives: This slice adds the helper and the final slice removes it

negatives: Conversion is documented in the README, and documentation for the API is generated

positives: Repeating [S-DTM], and Open-question #12 resolves the direction
negatives: A character range like [S-Z], and open questions about the feed
